description: Get detailed information about a specific invoice including all extracted data, payments, and tags. Returns top-level "currency", "comparable" (true if matches primary currency), "converted_to_primary", and "currency_warning" fields. Has TWO status fields: "processing_status" (OCR workflow stage) and "payment_status" (paid/unpaid). Amounts include both total_gross and total_net values in the amounts object. converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, source } when a bank reconciliation has recorded the actual settlement amount. Requires the Start or Business plan.
name: get_invoice_details
